title: In all kicker-based launchers, adding a new widget instance with an intentionally empty  favorite database will reset them to distribution default
line: Adding a new Kickoff, Kicker or Dashboard no longer brings back the default favorites after you removed them all.
explanation: Each new Kickoff, Kicker or Dashboard instance runs a one-time import of the default favorites when it is not marked as ported yet and the shared favorites database is empty. Since favorites became shared in 2017 that check is per widget, so removing every favorite and then adding another launcher re-imported the defaults into all launchers. The change makes the import skip when any launcher has already stored a favorites ordering in kactivitymanagerd-statsrc, which every import writes, so the defaults are imported once per user.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: import default favorites only once per user

Every new launcher with an empty favorites list imported the default
favorites again, even if the user had removed them on purpose. Skip the
import when a launcher has already stored favorites for this user.

BUG: 522392
